cards.name: Thunder Helm

cards.lore: Cuts through both armour and air resistance.

cards.name: Frost Hood

cards.lore: Keeps the head clear and cold in the heat of battle.

cards.lore: Enemies hesitate before striking frozen armour.

cards.lore: Friction is an afterthought on these boots.

cards.name: Frost Pendant

cards.name: Frost Wand

cards.lore: Aims best in the cold.

cards.description: Axe that bites like winter cold. +2 attack.
cards.lore: The edge never dulls — ice reforms it each morning.

cards.name: Ember Crown
cards.description: Crown forged in volcanic embers. +3 HP.
cards.lore: A ring of perpetual fire circles the brow.

cards.name: Ember Coat
cards.description: Coat woven from fire-resistant fibres. +5 HP.
cards.lore: It smells of campfire and old battles.

cards.name: Ember Vambraces
cards.description: Vambraces that heat up with every swing. +1 attack.
cards.lore: After a long fight they glow cherry red.

cards.name: Ember Greaves
cards.description: Greaves powered by thermal vents. +5 speed.
cards.lore: The exhaust leaves small scorched circles in the earth.

cards.name: Ember Locket
cards.description: Locket containing a piece of the first fire. +2 HP, +1 attack.
cards.lore: It opens to reveal only flame.

cards.name: Ember Staff
cards.description: Staff channelling combustive force far. +5 attack range.
cards.lore: The tip glows orange even on moonless nights.

cards.name: Ember Sword
cards.description: Sword that smoulders between strikes. +2 attack.
cards.lore: Quenching it only makes it angrier.

cards.name: Iron Helm
cards.description: Plain iron helm, sturdy as a rock. +3 HP.
cards.lore: Dented in every war it has survived.

cards.name: Iron Plate
cards.description: Solid iron plate armour. +5 HP.
cards.lore: Heavy, but the enemy always hits it first.

cards.name: Iron Bracers
cards.description: Iron bracers that add weight to each blow. +1 attack.
cards.lore: Blacksmiths make these in their sleep.

cards.name: Iron Greaves
cards.description: Iron greaves surprisingly swift for their weight. +5 speed.
cards.lore: Good ankles help.

cards.name: Iron Talisman
cards.description: Iron talisman shaped like an anvil. +2 HP, +1 attack.
cards.lore: The smith who forged it never lost a duel.

cards.name: Iron Crossbow
cards.description: Reliable iron crossbow with extended draw. +5 attack range.
cards.lore: Cheaper than a wand, deadlier than most.

cards.name: Iron Maul
cards.description: Iron maul that leaves a lasting impression. +2 attack.
cards.lore: Not subtle, but effective.

cards.name: Verdant Hood
cards.description: Hood woven from living vines. +3 HP.
cards.lore: Flowers bloom on it in spring.

cards.name: Verdant Vest
cards.description: Vest of layered bark and leaf. +5 HP.
cards.lore: The forest itself lends its protection.

cards.name: Verdant Bracers
cards.description: Bracers of ironwood. +1 attack.
cards.lore: The oldest trees give the strongest wood.

cards.name: Verdant Boots
cards.description: Boots that grip any terrain. +5 speed.
cards.lore: You can hear roots shifting to make way.

cards.name: Verdant Seed
cards.description: Seed of an ancient guardian tree. +2 HP, +1 attack.
cards.lore: It pulses warmly against the skin.

cards.name: Verdant Shortbow
cards.description: Shortbow carved from a living branch. +5 attack range.
cards.lore: The wood has never been cut — it grew this way.

cards.name: Verdant Club
cards.description: Club grown dense with nature's resilience. +2 attack.
cards.lore: It gets heavier with each fight.

cards.name: Shadow Hood
cards.description: Hood that blurs the wearer's outline. +6 HP.
cards.lore: Enemies strike where you were, not where you are.

cards.name: Shadow Cloak

cards.name: Shadow Gloves
cards.description: Gloves that darken every strike. +2 attack.
cards.lore: Silent strikes land harder.

cards.name: Shadow Wraps
cards.description: Leg wraps that dampen sound and friction. +10 speed.
cards.lore: Running through shadow requires no effort at all.

cards.name: Shadow Gem
cards.description: Gem that pulses with absorbed darkness. +4 HP, +2 attack.

cards.name: Shadow Sling

cards.lore: The stone disappears before it hits.

cards.name: Shadow Dagger
cards.description: Dagger forged in the penumbra. +4 attack.
cards.lore: It cuts shadow and bone equally.

cards.name: Storm Helm
cards.description: Helm forged in a tempest's eye. +6 HP.
cards.lore: The cheeks are pitted by a million tiny hailstones.

cards.name: Storm Mail
cards.description: Chain mail woven from storm-iron. +10 HP.
cards.lore: It hums in anticipation of the next storm.

cards.name: Storm Gauntlets
cards.description: Gauntlets that channel storm force. +2 attack.
cards.lore: Punching with these feels like punching lightning.

cards.name: Storm Greaves
cards.description: Greaves propelled by air pressure. +10 speed.
cards.lore: The wearer leaves small tornadoes in their wake.

cards.name: Storm Amulet
cards.description: Amulet containing a bottled hurricane. +4 HP, +2 attack.
cards.lore: Listen closely and hear the howling inside.

cards.name: Storm Bow
cards.description: Bow riding gale-force winds. +10 attack range.
cards.lore: Arrows from this bow have been found three towns over.

cards.name: Storm Hammer
cards.description: Hammer that brings thunder with every swing. +4 attack.
cards.lore: You can hear the boom before impact.

cards.name: Crimson Helm
cards.description: Helm stained with battlefield victory. +6 HP.
cards.lore: The red never washes out.

cards.name: Crimson Plate

cards.name: Crimson Gauntlets
cards.description: Gauntlets soaked in battle fervour. +2 attack.
cards.lore: The knuckles have seen a thousand faces.

cards.name: Crimson Cuisses
cards.description: Cuisses that drive the wearer forward. +10 speed.
cards.lore: Retreat is not in their vocabulary.

cards.name: Crimson Token
cards.description: Blood-red token of a warrior's pact. +4 HP, +2 attack.
cards.lore: An oath sworn in crimson cannot be broken.

cards.name: Crimson Crossbow
cards.description: Crossbow with a crimson stock. +10 attack range.
cards.lore: The red sight never misses the mark.

cards.name: Crimson Cleaver
cards.description: Cleaver that grows sharper with each use. +4 attack.
cards.lore: It has never been sharpened — only used.

cards.name: Obsidian Helm
cards.description: Helm of volcanic glass. +6 HP.

cards.name: Obsidian Bracers

cards.name: Obsidian Greaves

cards.name: Obsidian Blade

cards.name: Aurora Crown

cards.name: Aurora Jewel

cards.name: Aurora Sword

cards.name: Venom Fang

cards.name: Venom Blade

cards.name: Elder Sandals

cards.name: Jade Greaves

cards.name: Jade Lotus

cards.name: Jade Mace

cards.name: Blood Crown

cards.name: Blood Plate

cards.name: Blood Gauntlets

cards.name: Blood Greaves

cards.name: Blood Pendant

cards.name: Blood Crossbow

cards.name: Blood Sword

cards.name: Crystal Bracers
cards.description: Bracers that focus magical energy. +5 attack.

cards.name: Crystal Boots

cards.name: Crystal Blade

cards.name: Bone Crown

cards.name: Bone Plate

cards.name: Bone Gauntlets

cards.name: Bone Greaves
cards.description: Bone greaves of the death runner. +30 speed.

cards.name: Bone Token
cards.description: Token of the undying pact. +25 HP, +8 attack.

cards.name: Bone Bow

cards.name: Bone Cleaver

cards.name: Solar Gauntlets

cards.lore: The impact leaves a sunburst mark.

cards.name: Solar Greaves

cards.name: Solar Disc

cards.name: Solar Sword

cards.name: Void Wraps
cards.description: Wraps pulling strength from the void. +8 attack.
cards.lore: They punch through dimensions. Literal ones.

cards.name: Void Boots
cards.description: Boots stepping through void space. +30 speed.
cards.lore: Each step skips a metre of intervening reality.

cards.name: Void Gem
cards.description: Gem containing a pinhole to the void. +25 HP, +8 attack.
cards.lore: If you look inside it long enough, it looks back.

cards.name: Void Sling
cards.description: Sling launching projectiles through void shortcuts. +55 attack range.
cards.lore: The stone disappears and reappears at the target.

cards.name: Void Blade
cards.description: Blade that exists and doesn't. +20 attack.
cards.lore: Armour is irrelevant to something that is simultaneously everywhere and nowhere.

cards.name: Granite Helm
cards.description: Helm carved from mountain granite. +35 HP.
cards.lore: The mountain it came from collapsed without it.

cards.name: Granite Plate
cards.description: Granite plate of the earth's endurance. +50 HP.
cards.lore: Geologists weep when they see it used as armour.

cards.name: Granite Gauntlets
cards.description: Gauntlets of sheer geological force. +8 attack.
cards.lore: Impact craters are a common result.

cards.name: Granite Boots
cards.description: Granite boots with inexplicable spring. +30 speed.
cards.lore: The wearer should not be this fast. Yet here we are.

cards.name: Granite Talisman
cards.description: Talisman of the mountain spirit. +25 HP, +8 attack.
cards.lore: The mountain spirit gave this up reluctantly.

cards.name: Granite Crossbow
cards.description: Crossbow that fires granite bolts at ludicrous range. +55 attack range.
cards.lore: Loading it requires a small crane.

cards.name: Granite Maul
cards.description: Maul as heavy as a mountain. +20 attack.
cards.lore: The impact registers on seismographs.
